In about [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Wyrd]], a group of [[Tarasin]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] attempted to turn the [[Ch'hala tree|ch'hala]] [[Heart Tree]] to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], to allow them to take over the ecology of Cularin. However, they were '''confronted''' by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]], who attempted to thwart the Wyrd's plans. Qel-Bertuk sacrificed himself to save the tree and he merged his [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] into the ch'hala, while the agents defeated the witches.
